name: setUserColor
description: Set the profile's theme user colour via ThemeService::SetUserColorAndBrowserColorVariant (prefs browser.theme.user_color2 + color_variant2). Omit `color` to clear the user colour and fall back to the default palette. Like setColorScheme this repaints the guest through the existing nexus-theme push. Returns {ok:true}.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Seed colour as "#rrggbb" (case-insensitive). Absent or empty clears the user colour.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: Colour variant: "tonalSpot", "neutral", "vibrant" or "expressive". Defaults to tonalSpot when absent.
